comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The mobile Google SERP leaves a broken AI Overview panel (only the sparkle icon and the "Не удалось сгенерировать обзор…" error) because the filter blocks its async/folsrch request; an unfiltered control renders the real overview. Adding google.com#⁠#⁠div[⁠data-async-type="folsrch"]⁠ to the existing "! Google Search - AI Overview" block in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt verified clean (panel hidden, page intact), covering the page the older :⁠has() wrapper rule at line 354 no longer hides. ## Rule `google.com##div[data-async-type="folsrch"]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No closing rule in the run instruction applies:⁠ this is not a paywall, not a self-promotion banner, not an anti-adblock wall and not a scam page — it is an empty/broken leftover of a module the filter already blocks on purpose. It is a missed leftover on a fully reachable page, so it gets a rule; the AdGuard Other Annoyances purpose (irritating in-page elements) covers the broken AI Overview shell, and google.com has ample traffic. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c8892e39d7c9aab33d8841e45827df5c4a7dc7ce/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Other annoyances - Uncategorized`, before [line 357](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c8892e39d7c9aab33d8841e45827df5c4a7dc7ce/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt#L357). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"79fa9835e8fbb3c5146a12b49833c0b99b10124fdc60c1a956331a9540940610"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The reported in-player Hulu ad could not be reproduced:⁠ the reported watch URL 301-redirects to the unsigned-in Castle series page, and complete full-page vision of that page (reporterSymptomPresence absent, 0 instances) shows no player, ad, placeholder or gap. The repository's existing "Hulu video ads" rules (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt 22787-22794, replace.txt line 10) were active, so no new rule is warranted; a maintainer with a Hulu subscription should verify the player case before closing.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The AdguardFilters run instruction states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is an ads report (T:⁠ Ads, P1:⁠ Critical) and none of the instruction's closing categories (paywall, unreachable anti-adblock detector without a captured detector script, scam page) is established by the evidence. Policy lookup (KnowledgeBase filter-policy.md + CONTRIBUTING.md) returned no criterion that refuses an ad-blocking rule for a streaming player, so rule generation is allowed and the decision rests on reproduction.
